test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about ‘Loo’ winds in the context of the Indian climate?

options.text: They blow in the winter and rainy season.
They blow in the summer season.
They blow in the winter season.
They blow in the rainy season.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They blow in the summer season.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Loo winds** are hot and dry winds that blow over the plains of North India and Pakistan during the summer season.
 
• The temperature associated with these winds can reach up to **45-50 degrees Celsius**, causing severe heatwaves.
 
• They typically occur between the months of **May and June**.
 
• Exposure to Loo winds can lead to dehydration and heat strokes, making them hazardous to health.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term **'Loo'** is derived from the local language and has been used traditionally to describe these winds.
 
• The regions most affected by Loo winds include the states of **Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh**, and parts of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• People in these regions often stay indoors during the peak afternoon hours to avoid the adverse effects of the Loo.
 
• Traditional measures to combat the Loo include drinking plenty of water, using cooling drinks like buttermilk, and wearing light-colored, loose-fitting clothes.
